from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util, sys, json, hashlib, copy
from talkcut.project import init_project, artifact_ref, atomic_json, TalkCutError
ROOT = FIXTURE_ROOT
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = FIXTURE_SOURCE
assert hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == FIXTURE_SOURCE_SHA
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('talkcut.privacy_checks_independent_staged', SOURCE)
privacy = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = privacy
spec.loader.exec_module(privacy)
rows = []

def setup(name, key='runner', old_body=None, current_body=None, namespace='capability/runtime'):
    case = HERE / name
    case.mkdir()
    screen = case / 'screen.bin'
    speaker = case / 'speaker.bin'
    screen.write_bytes(b'authored private screen identity ' + name.encode())
    speaker.write_bytes(b'authored private speaker identity ' + name.encode())
    directory = case / 'project'
    project = init_project(directory, screen, speaker)
    sources = {role: v['sha256'] for role, v in project['sources'].items()}
    original = directory / namespace / 'runner.py'
    original.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    phrase = 'A deliberately authored private observation about five copper birds entering an indigo room.'
    original.write_text(old_body or '# ' + phrase + '\nprint("old local run")\n')
    old = artifact_ref(original)
    preserved = case / 'preserved-old-source.py'
    preserved.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
    metadata = directory / 'capability' / 'state.json'
    metadata.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(metadata, {'state': 'running', 'source_sha256': sources['screen'], key: old})
    old_metadata = artifact_ref(metadata)
    metadata_archive = case / 'preserved-old-metadata'
    metadata_archive.write_bytes(metadata.read_bytes())
    original.write_text(current_body or 'print("current local run")\n')
    atomic_json(metadata, {'state': 'done'})
    atomic_json(directory / 'checkpoint.local.json', {'source_sha256': sources['screen'], 'past_execution': old_metadata})
    kwargs = {'auxiliary_metadata_history': [{'original': old_metadata, 'snapshot': artifact_ref(metadata_archive)}], 'source_snapshots': [{'original': old, 'snapshot': artifact_ref(preserved), 'scope': 'auxiliary_execution_source'}]}
    return (case, directory, sources, original, preserved, metadata, metadata_archive, kwargs, phrase)
# for key in ['runner'
